remarks: Expanded Cape with Space, Character & Endless Possibilities! Welcome home to this move-in ready expanded 1942 Cape offering over 2,100 square feet of living space and a versatile layout that could accommodate 4 bedrooms, depending on your needs. The thoughtfully expanded floor plan offers a spacious living room, additional family/bonus room, loft/bedroom, partial finished basement with an office/bonus room that could also serve as a bedroom and convenient access to the garage. The kitchen features oak cabinetry, pull-out drawers, a breakfast bar, abundant storage and all appliances included. The living room is hardwired for a sound system, perfect for entertaining or relaxing at home. The primary bedroom includes an additional bonus room that could be utilized as a walk-in closet, dressing area or additional flex space, with existing plumbing and wiring for a potential Jacuzzi. Additional highlights include a new furnace, two gas ventless fireplaces, and drain tile throughout the complete yard. Step outside and enjoy the wraparound deck, spacious yard, mature trees, gardens, storage shed and the added privacy of no rear neighbors. There is plenty of room to entertain, garden, play or simply enjoy your own outdoor retreat. Conveniently located just minutes from the airport, expressway/Thruway, shopping, schools, restaurants and everyday amenities, this home offers both character and convenience.
